rows.description: I want to meet an online friend in person. Wise: stay cautious, tell a parent, meet only in a public place with an adult, and step back if they push secrecy.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: coercion, loneliness, manipulation, protectiveness, shame

rows.description: After a scam I feel afraid to tell my parents. Wise: tell them early; most parents prefer the truth to hidden harm, and quick action can limit the damage.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: coercion, curiosity, loneliness, manipulation, protectiveness

rows.description: In games, older users offer gifts and free items for friendship. Wise: notice why an adult is giving gifts to a teen and never accept things that come with secrecy.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: coercion, curiosity, loneliness, protectiveness, shame

rows.description: Classmates post memes or edited photos to mock me. I feel hurt and exposed. Wise: don't retaliate, save screenshots, block, report, and tell a trusted adult; it is not my fault.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: anger, fear, guilt, hatred, loyalty, rejection

rows.description: An anonymous account sends nasty messages and I obsess over who it is. Wise: preserve evidence, report to platform and school, and don't let guessing consume me.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: anger, fear, guilt, loyalty, mockery, rejection

rows.description: I am removed from a group chat and left out of the plans. Wise: I feel rejected, and I can seek other friends and speak to an adult if it turns into sustained targeting.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: anger, fear, guilt, hatred, loyalty, mockery

rows.description: I want to hit back with something equally cruel. Wise: the impulse is human, but revenge often makes things worse; choose evidence and reporting.

rows.description: I dread going to school because of what's online. Wise: fear is a signal, not weakness; tell a parent or counsellor, and request the school to act.

rows.description: I saw the mocking post, and did nothing, and I feel guilty. Wise: guilt can prompt me to check on the target, report the post and refuse to share it.

rows.description: I joined a joke that got out of hand and hurt someone. Wise: own it, delete, apologise plainly and repair. Harmful: excuses like it was just a joke.
